content: Rather than recommend a single horror film or an unsettling album for our final installment of spooky season recs, I present you with a small selection of creepy, disturbing, and just plain weird videos from YouTube. There’s a little something for everyone here. Whether you’re a fan of surreal art house shorts, cosmic horror, or classic viral clips, you’re bound to find something below that will get you in the Halloween spirit. [Media: https://youtu.be/iLJNSD3H5sg] Possibly in Michigan This 1983 short film from Cecelia Condit found its audience over 30 years later when it was uploaded to YouTube and eventually found its way to Reddit. If you’ve ever wondered what a feminist musical about cannibals directed by David Lynch would be like, wonder no more. Possibly in Michigan is only 12 minutes long, but it has inspired hours of YouTube videos dedicated to analyzing its deeply unsettling imagery and meaning. [Media: https://youtu.be/SFJOHlnoQNM] Homemade Gatorade The line between horror and comedy is razor thin, and Homemade Gatorade expertly threads that line. It’s bizarre, uncomfortable, and uncanny. It blends stiff animation with heavily processed video to create something quite unique. I’m never sure if I should be laughing or squirming in terror with every turn this road trip short takes. [Media: https://youtu.be/BI9fKfX5V68] Portrait of God Big budget cosmic horror films often make the same mistake — they try to show too much. What makes Portrait of God work is it knows less is more. So much of its short runtime is spent staring into an empty abyss. Or is it empty… [Media: https://youtu.be/HVQzEzW4faA] Heck Speaking of staring intently at nothing and wondering if you did actually see anything, Heck is the short that eventually was turned into the experimental horror Skinamarink. Personally, I love Skinamarink, but I understand it’s not for everyone. 100 minutes is a long time to be staring into staticky corners of a drab suburban home. Heck delivers the same tension-building quiet, but in a much more digestible 29 minutes. [Media: https://youtu.be/ns1SGo3WCF4] Dining Room or There is Nothing There’s not much to say about this one-minute loopable short from David B Earle. It’s the sort of video that did gangbusters on early YouTube. It’s all abstract creepiness and nightmare-fuel visuals. If you want the full effect and need something to put on the TV at your Halloween party, put on this four-hour looped version. [Media: https://youtu.be/-aH-pP3PAIc] Spirit Halloween Theme No Halloween is complete without this banger from Nick Lutsko.

chineseContent: 我不会为我们最后一季的恐怖片推荐一部恐怖电影或一张令人不安的专辑，而是向您展示一小部分来自 YouTube 的令人毛骨悚然、令人不安且非常奇怪的视频。这里有适合每个人的东西。无论您是超现实艺术短片、宇宙恐怖片还是经典病毒剪辑的粉丝，您一定会在下面找到一些能让您感受到万圣节气氛的内容。 [媒体：https://youtu.be/iLJNSD3H5sg] 可能在密歇根州 这部由塞西莉亚·康迪特 (Cecelia Condit) 于 1983 年拍摄的短片在上传到 YouTube 并最终登陆 Reddit 后，在 30 多年后找到了观众。如果您曾经想知道大卫·林奇执导的一部关于食人者的女权主义音乐剧会是什么样子，那就不用再想了。 《可能在密歇根》的长度只有 12 分钟，但它却激发了 YouTube 上数小时的视频，专门分析其令人深感不安的图像和含义。 [媒体：https://youtu.be/SFJOHlnoQNM] 自制佳得乐 恐怖和喜剧之间的界限非常细，而自制佳得乐巧妙地贯穿了这条线。这很奇怪、不舒服、而且不可思议。它将僵硬的动画与经过严格处理的视频融合在一起，创造出非常独特的东西。我不确定在这段短暂的公路旅行中，我是应该大笑，还是应该在恐惧中蠕动。 [媒体：https://youtu.be/BI9fKfX5V68] 上帝的肖像 大预算的宇宙恐怖片经常犯同样的错误——它们试图表现得太多。 《上帝肖像》之所以能发挥作用，是因为它知道“少即是多”。它短暂的运行时间大部分时间都花在凝视空荡荡的深渊上。或者它是空的...... [媒体：https://youtu.be/HVQzEzW4faA] Heck 说到专注地盯着什么东西，想知道你是否真的看到了任何东西，Heck 是最终变成实验恐怖片 S 的短片
